note: Calibration set for PRD §8.1 (refusal threshold). Split into queries the indexed corpus genuinely covers and queries it genuinely does not. IN-CORPUS entries name products that actually have an ingested document (verified against the live `documents` table on 2026-09-09); OUT-OF-CORPUS entries are either unrelated topics or manufactured-product categories with no ingested document. Nothing here asserts an expected standard number — this set measures retrieval score magnitude only, not answer correctness. See scripts/calibrate-refusal-threshold.ts.
